tasks.short: Start boat motors and monitor signs of malfunction

steps.what: Check the actual motor and test setup and determine that the intended start can proceed
inputs: actual motor, test setup and operating instructions

steps.what: Start the actual boat motor using the intended local controls
outputs: actual started motor or observed start failure

steps.what: Monitor actual motor performance for smoke, excessive vibration, misfiring and other signs of malfunction
inputs: actual started motor or observed start failure
actual operating behaviour and test conditions

tasks.design: Keep starting and observing the actual motor with the mechanic. The start action follows the actual readiness check; no new sensor, diagnostic feed or software control is established that would remove observation of smoke, vibration or misfiring.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work depends on the actual motor's behaviour during a physical test.
tasks.enabler_now: No supported software change is established for this task's physical observations.
tasks.still_hard: Smoke, vibration and intermittent misfiring require interpretation in the test context.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise abnormal behaviour and stop or investigate appropriately.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: starting a boat motor and interpreting smoke, vibration and misfiring remain physical diagnostic work without a specified change to sensing or test control.

assumptions: Shares are provisional and unmeasured, not engine runtime. The readiness check is the mechanic's actual pre-start work, not an added approval meeting.
No structured telemetry or automatic diagnostic conclusion is assumed. Inputs are the actual motor and its observed behaviour.
This statement requires starting and monitoring, not a separate report. Actual inspection/test documentation is explicitly represented in task 13765 and must not be counted twice.
All work remains; gross/net saving are zero and there is no new upkeep.
unknowns: Actual test controls and available diagnostic equipment
research_questions: Does the actual test setup contain a native diagnostic feature that changes human monitoring work?

incremental.description: No new test system or workflow proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No verified change to physical motor starting or performance observation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document actual inspection results and performed or planned work

steps.what: Review the actual inspection observations, test readings and work performed or still required for this boat and engine
inputs: mechanic's actual inspection/test observations and readings
actual work order and performed or planned repair details
outputs: mechanic-checked facts for the service record

steps.what: Enter the actual inspection and test results and work performed or to be performed, then check the completed service record
inputs: mechanic-checked facts for the service record
actual boat/engine identity and work-order fields

steps.what: Save the completed checked service record on the existing work order

tasks.design: Configure existing work-order fields and native verbatim dictation in {OPS_SYSTEM}, the marine-service work-order application, where supported. The mechanic supplies the actual results and explicitly distinguishes performed from planned work, corrects the full record and saves that checked version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Typing service observations can slow the documentation explicitly required by the task.
tasks.enabler_now: Native form fields and verbatim dictation can reduce typing without inferring repair completion.
tasks.still_hard: Test meaning, units, engine identity and whether work was actually performed must be checked.
tasks.human_edge: State what really happened and what remains to be done.

ambition.what: No automatic release or extra repair capacity claimed.

build_days.consent_and_access: 1-4 for device access and approved speech processing; consult staff if capture settings change

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native service forms and verbatim dictation can reduce typing while the mechanic supplies and checks actual results and work status.

assumptions: Shares are provisional documentation effort, not a measured organisation baseline or time for the physical inspection itself.
OPS_SYSTEM means marine-service work-order software. The mechanic produces actual observations and performed/planned status; existing job records supply boat/engine identity.
No new structured diagnostic feed is assumed. Speaking, choosing facts, checking every number/unit/negation and correcting transcription remain inside s2; no model summarises or invents completion.

Gross provisional saving 16.8 minus 1.5 hours of form/dictation-setting upkeep gives 15.3 net. Existing equivalent dictation/form support or no permitted native dictation removes the corresponding gain.
Save remains negligible and fully retained. Ordinary final checking is in s2, with no separate self-approval step; no customer send, billing or release is proposed.
unknowns: Current entry method, supported native dictation and correction effort
research_questions: Does native verbatim dictation reduce total real record-entry time after correction of technical terms and readings?

already_counted.description: Supply actual facts, dictate/enter the record and correct its complete content

incremental.description: Maintain form fields and approved dictation settings and check changed technical vocabulary

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Below provisional net 15.3%; technical transcription errors or existing native support can remove all gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Idle motors and assess cooling-system effectiveness

steps.what: Determine the intended idle-test setting from the actual motor instructions and current test condition
inputs: motor's actual idle-test and cooling instructions

steps.what: Set and maintain the actual motor at the selected idle-test setting
outputs: actual idling motor under the selected test condition

steps.what: Observe actual thermometers and the cooling response while the motor idles
inputs: actual idling motor under the selected test condition

steps.what: Interpret the observed temperatures and conditions to determine the actual cooling system's effectiveness
inputs: motor's actual cooling requirements and test conditions

tasks.design: Retain the physical idle test and thermometer observation with the mechanic. Test setting, control action, observation and interpretation are explicit; no data logger or software change is established that would remove this work.
tasks.previous_blocker: The cooling response must be observed on the actual idling motor.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional supported change to the physical test is assumed.
tasks.still_hard: Temperature meaning depends on actual loading, coolant flow and test conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Judge whether the actual cooling behaviour warrants further investigation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: an idle cooling test requires actual temperature observation and contextual mechanical interpretation unless a specific changed test system is established.

assumptions: Shares describe provisional human effort, not elapsed idle or cooling time.
The actual motor and thermometers produce the observed evidence; no structured sensor stream or automatic normal/fault label is invented.
Documentation of these actual results belongs to task 13765 and must be deduplicated in a roll-up; no record requirement in this test statement is omitted.
All test actions remain, so gross and net saving are zero and no added upkeep is required.
unknowns: Actual test setup and current temperature-logging equipment
research_questions: Does the actual motor/test equipment offer an approved native feature that removes human test work?

incremental.description: No new system or test process proposed

time_saved_range_pct.basis: No supported change to actual idle testing, thermometer reading or interpretation.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

skills_to_grow: Distinguish performed work from planned work
Check technical readings and record provenance
role.ambitious_version: Reduce service-record typing while retaining hands-on engine testing and mechanical judgment.
